intro: Shields up? Doesn't matter. I hit first.
You look slow. Let's find out.
The vanguard never waits. Neither will I.
win: That's how the vanguard does it.
lose: Fine. You earned that one.
Next time I hit harder.

intro: Oh, a new audience! Let's make it bright.
Do you like fireworks? You will.
Stand back. Or don't, it's more fun.
win: What a show! Same time tomorrow?
lose: Aw. The fire's out. For now.
You stole my finale!

intro: Hmph. Let's see if your work holds up.
Every gear in its place. Is yours?
I've no time for sloppy craft. Show me yours.
low: A crack in the casting. It happens.
win: Solid work beats clever work. Every time.
Back to the anvil with you.
lose: Well forged. I'll grant you that.
Hmph. Not bad. Not bad at all.

intro: The line holds. It always holds.
State your business, challenger.
Formation! We have company.
lose: The line... broke. Well fought.
I'll drill them twice as hard.

intro: Oh, a visitor. The dead are always glad of company.
Mind the soil, dear. It remembers.
Every harvest begins with a little sorrow.
low: How lovely. I'll be resting soon.
win: There, there. You'll rise again tomorrow.
lose: You have a living person's luck.
Come back soon. They'll miss you.

intro: Sign here, and here. The terms are very fair.
Every duel is a contract. Shall we begin?
I see you read the small print. How rare.
win: The terms have been met. I'll collect later.
lose: A loophole. How annoying.
Our agreement is void. For today.

intro: Sit. The grove is in no hurry.
Roots take time. So will you.
Hush. Listen to the leaves first.
win: The forest thanks you for visiting.
lose: A good storm. The grove will grow back.
You walk lightly. That is wise.

intro: Hunt's on.
Run.
I've tracked worse.
lose: You got away.
Hm. Respect.

intro: You may begin. Try not to embarrass yourself.
I have read every move you could make. Twice.
A lesson, then. Take notes.
lose: Fascinating. I must revise my notes.
An anomaly. It will not repeat.

intro: Another climber. Let's see how far you get.
The Spire has outlasted a thousand of you.
I've watched many fall. Don't rush to join them.
lose: Well. That has not happened in a while.
Climb on, then. The top awaits.

conditions.name: Scorched Earth
conditions.text: At the start of each turn, the player whose turn it is loses 1 life.

unlock: The mountain rumbles. Something below has woken.
intro: SMALL THING. YOU SMELL OF ASH ALREADY.
THE MOUNTAIN REMEMBERS EVERY FOOL WHO CLIMBED IT.
lose: THE MOUNTAIN... SLEEPS. FOR NOW.

conditions.name: Fortress
conditions.text: All creatures enter the battlefield with +0/+2.

unlock: Deep in the foundry, an engine older than the city starts to turn.
intro: INTRUDER DETECTED. ASSESSING.
PROTOCOL: DEFEND. PROTOCOL: DESTROY.
lose: SHUTTING... DOWN...

unlock: The graves are restless tonight. Their king is listening.
intro: Kneel, and I may let you serve me after.
Every throne needs a floor. You will do.
low: Death has always been kind to me.
win: Rise, servant. You belong to me now.
lose: I will wait. I am very good at waiting.

unlock: The whole forest has gone quiet. Something ancient is paying attention.
intro: ...you are... very... small...
...the forest... sees you...
lose: ...a new season... begins...

conditions.name: Forbidden Library
conditions.text: Everyone draws an extra card at the start of each turn.

unlock: At the top of the Spire, a light that has not shone for years is burning.
intro: So you climbed my tower. Impressive. And futile.
I have unmade better challengers before breakfast.
win: Return to the bottom of the stairs.
lose: Remarkable. Perhaps you will take my place one day.
